## Analysis

sol_0041 shows that affine composition of the 66-element incumbent is also saturated: exhaustive two-copy placements and tempered unions of up to seven copies produced no improvement. Together with sol_0037–0040, this rules out single-point, blockwise, conditional-fringe, boundary, and repeated-copy escapes around sol_0036. The remaining opportunity is not further refinement of that basin but globally different dense-core/fringe topologies, especially wider asymmetric fringes whose useful coordinates must change jointly.
